label: ping
description: Collapse ping echo replies to the round-trip statistics a reader actually needs.

tests.name: inline sample
tests.input:
PING example.com (93.184.216.34): 56 data bytes
64 bytes from 93.184.216.34: icmp_seq=0 ttl=56 time=11.1 ms
64 bytes from 93.184.216.34: icmp_seq=1 ttl=56 time=11.2 ms
64 bytes from 93.184.216.34: icmp_seq=2 ttl=56 time=11.3 ms

--- example.com ping statistics ---
3 packets transmitted, 3 packets received, 0.0% packet loss
round-trip min/avg/max/mdev = 11.108/11.208/11.292/0.090 ms
tests.expected:
PING example.com (93.184.216.34): 56 data bytes

--- example.com ping statistics ---
3 packets transmitted, 3 packets received, 0.0% packet loss
round-trip min/avg/max/mdev = 11.108/11.208/11.292/0.090 ms

tests.name: unreachable host keeps the failure
tests.input:
PING nosuchhost.invalid (1.2.3.4): 56 data bytes
Request timeout for icmp_seq 0

--- nosuchhost.invalid ping statistics ---
1 packets transmitted, 0 packets received, 100% packet loss
tests.expected:
PING nosuchhost.invalid (1.2.3.4): 56 data bytes

--- nosuchhost.invalid ping statistics ---
1 packets transmitted, 0 packets received, 100% packet loss
